reference.start_policy: Each agent phase or replacement requires an explicit operator action.

ceilings.reservation: Reserve the admitted maxima; terminal reconciliation retains authoritative charged usage, including unknown attempts.

cases.expected: An assessment and explicitly started planning run bind exact programme revision, task/run/objective, source and input fingerprint; both reopen after restart.
Unrelated notes retain current results. A material target change stales affected assessment/planning descendants without erasing history or starting work.
Programme list/read/history/attachment access respects principal, workspace and execution mode.
Duplicate mutation keys reuse the durable operation; competing expected revisions allow only one write.
An error before outer commit rolls back programme mutation, task, phase link, reservation and receipt, and discards dispatch callbacks.
A dispatch callback failure preserves the admitted queued task and receipt. Restart recovers that exact task instead of admitting another.
Terminal task runs are read directly; projections never silently follow a task current_run_id or inherit acceptance from a later run.
Source holds, withdrawal, stale applicability or revoked access withhold current claims without requiring a programme edit.
One-active, per-phase attempts, total runs and reserved maxima apply before admission, including generic task corrections/Continue attempts.
Cancellation remains terminal, charged calls remain charged, late outputs cannot become current and no replacement starts automatically.
